reviews: M3.1-architect.json revision r1 (re-review of r0 NEEDS_REVISION)
summary: All four r0 CRITICALs are genuinely resolved against the ACTUAL code, and the most dangerous regression vector the prompt flagged — enabling 16/8-bit storage device features UNCONDITIONALLY at device creation and thereby breaking the existing saxpy/vector_add dispatch on Lavapipe — is correctly avoided: the revised context.rs spec PROBES each feature via VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 and enables only the device-SUPPORTED subset, failing closed with the typed DeviceFeatureUnsupported only at DISPATCH of a kernel that needs an absent feature. Verified: (C1) CoopMatKey is currently {elem,m,n,use_} with NO k/result_type and CoopMatrixShape is {m,n,k,a/b/c_elem} with NO result_type/scope (coopmat.rs:206-211,218-226) — the r1 extensions are additive and feasible; K is derivable because each coopmat arg is a LocalRead(BindingId) whose Binding carries BindingTy::CoopMatrix(CoopMatKey) (expr.rs:32,45-48,97) and the A-matrix key's .n IS K (M2.1 KDimMismatch typecheck guarantees a.n==b.m, coopmat.rs:81), so derive_coopmat_shape can source M=a.m,N=b.n,K=a.n,result=accumulator.elem with NO new validation; the driver's compile_source_with_meta already holds the HIR kernel in scope (lib.rs:114) to fill metadata.coopmat. (C2/C3) required_device_features is derivable from binding_plan.buffers[].ty via the EXISTING needs_16bit_storage()/needs_8bit_storage() helpers (buffer.rs:76,84); the capability->feature table covers EVERY capability actually emitted (verified emit.rs:146-355 emits Shader/VulkanMemoryModel/CooperativeMatrixKHR/Float16/StorageBuffer16BitAccess/Int8/StorageBuffer8BitAccess/Int16, q4_0.rs:49-50,94-95,151-152), the 'shaderFloat16 NOT needed' claim is CORRECT (all f16 is inside coopmat ops or immediately OpFConvert'd to f32 in the q4km path — no scalar f16 ALU), and the FIRST-8/16-bit-dispatch reality is confirmed (only compile_q4km_* exist; saxpy/vector_add are the only dispatched kernels today; context.rs:344-356 enables ONLY timeline_semaphore). (C4) the non-symmetric fixture is numerically transpose-distinguishing — computed max|AB-AtB|=746, |AB-ABt|=330, |AB-BA|=664, |AB-(AB)^T|=157, all O(100x) the f16 tol (~5 at |C|~512), so a transposed/swapped/mis-strided coopmat_load CANNOT pass AT-1510. No new BLOCKING hole; three NON-blocking implementation notes recorded for the Coder. Coding may proceed.

critical_resolution_verdicts.C1_coopmat_shape_metadata: RESOLVED. The end-to-end plumbing is feasible and sound against actual types. CoopMatKey/CoopMatrixShape extensions are purely additive (verified current shapes lack k+result_type). K-derivation is sound: matmul_tile's mul_add args are LocalRead bindings resolvable via the bindings table to BindingTy::CoopMatrix(CoopMatKey); A-key.n == K and M2.1 KDimMismatch guarantees a.n==b.m, so no new validation is needed. Metadata schema 1->2 with #[serde(default)] genuinely preserves the M0-M2.6 v1 sidecar corpus (current load_kernel_metadata HARD-REJECTS version!=1 at metadata.rs:114, so the relaxation to accept {1,2} is real and specified, HN-13/AT-1553). compile_source_with_meta holds the HIR kernel (lib.rs:114) so .with_coopmat() is wireable. HN-10/AT-1551/AT-1552 'nothing hardcoded' is now ACHIEVABLE; the r0 HN-10-vs-AT-1551 contradiction is gone.
critical_resolution_verdicts.C2_16bit_storage_feature: RESOLVED. required_device_features(binding_plan, uses_coopmat) derives storage_16bit from binding_plan.buffers[].ty.needs_16bit_storage() (helper EXISTS, buffer.rs:76); decision is binding-plan-driven (plain f16 SSBO kernels covered), not coopmat-presence. VulkanMemoryModel (HN-1) is in the table. context.rs chains VkPhysicalDevice16BitStorageFeatures CONDITIONALLY (probe via Features2, enable only if device-supported), fail-closed DeviceFeatureUnsupported at dispatch. AT-1509 isolates pipeline-create. No emitted capability is left unmapped that would fail pipeline-create on NVIDIA.
critical_resolution_verdicts.C3_8bit_int8_int16_feature: RESOLVED. Same pass derives storage_8bit/shader_int8 (needs_8bit_storage(), buffer.rs:84) and shader_int16 (q4km f16_bits_to_f32 path, q4_0.rs:151-152). Table maps Int8->shaderInt8, StorageBuffer8BitAccess->storageBuffer8BitAccess, Int16->shaderInt16, all conditionally enabled. Confirmed this is genuinely the FIRST 8/16-bit dispatch (no q4km dispatch test exists today). AT-1522 isolates q4km pipeline-create.
critical_resolution_verdicts.C4_transpose_fixture: RESOLVED. CPU-computed the four products for A[i][j]=1+0.5i-0.25j, B[i][j]=-0.5+0.5j+0.125i: AB in [-122,831], max|AB-AtB|=746.25, max|AB-ABt|=330.0, max|AB-BA|=663.75, max|AB-(AB)^T|=157.5; A and B are both NON-symmetric. With f16 tol ~5 at the |C| magnitudes, every transpose/swap/stride variant differs by 30x-150x the tolerance band. AT-1512 (CPU-only guard) genuinely proves a transposed/mis-strided load fails AT-1510.

warnings: NON-BLOCKING (derive_coopmat_shape under-describes binding-ref resolution): The design says derive_coopmat_shape 'walks the typed body for the coopmat ops' and reads a.m/a.n etc. But in matmul_tile the mul_add operands are LocalRead(BindingId) (let a=...; coopmat_mul_add(a,b,acc)), so HirExpr.ty is a ScalarTy (element only) and the M/N/K dims live in the referenced Binding's BindingTy::CoopMatrix(CoopMatKey). The helper MUST resolve args[0]/args[1] BindingIds through body.bindings (use Binding::as_coopmat()) to get K, NOT read HirExpr.ty. Both the inline-Load case (args[i].result_ty present) and the binding-ref case (the matmul_tile case) must be handled. The machinery exists; this is an implementation detail to pin in the Coder handoff, not a design gap.

NON-BLOCKING (derive_coopmat_shape 'first mul_add' is correct for M3.1 but document the single-tile assumption): The residual-risk note 'takes first mul_add' is fine for matmul_tile (one mul_add). For a future multi-accumulation kernel, all mul_adds in a coopmat kernel must share M/N/K (same tile shape) or the single kernel-level CoopMatShape is ill-defined. M3.1 kernels are single-shape; add a debug_assert that any subsequent mul_add's derived shape equals the first, to fail loudly if a future kernel violates this.

NON-BLOCKING (AT-1512 omits the output-transpose variant): AT-1512 asserts (AB,AtB),(AB,ABt),(AB,BA) differ beyond 10x tol but not (AB,(AB)^T) — the classic row-major-vs-column-major OUTPUT store-stride bug. Computed max|AB-(AB)^T|=157.5 (>>tol), and AT-1510's elementwise compare would catch it anyway, so this is covered transitively; optionally add the (AB,(AB)^T) pair to AT-1512 for completeness.
spirv_concerns: Re-verified the emitted-capability set is fully covered: emit.rs emits Shader (146), VulkanMemoryModel (151), CooperativeMatrixKHR (321), Float16 (331), StorageBuffer16BitAccess+SPV_KHR_16bit_storage (337-338), Int8 (346), StorageBuffer8BitAccess+SPV_KHR_8bit_storage (349-350), Int16 (355); q4_0.rs sets int8/storage_8bit (49-50,94-95) and int16/float16 (151-152). The r1 capability->feature table has a row for each. spirv-val validates the module but NOT device-feature enablement — the design correctly separates this (AT-1509/1522 pipeline-create) and no capability is left without a feature mapping that would fail pipeline-create on NVIDIA.

saturatingAccumulation==VK_FALSE: codegen emits NONE_KHR operands (coopmat.rs:189) -> non-saturating; the r1 matcher now requires saturating_accumulation==false AND compares result_type (sourced from metadata via the new CoopMatKey.result_type). r0 WARNING addressed.
vendor_concerns: Lavapipe REGRESSION RISK (the prompt's load-bearing question): RESOLVED. The r1 context.rs spec (files_to_modify context.rs + feature_chain_assembly) PROBES each candidate feature via VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 and enables ONLY the device-supported subset; an unavailable feature is NOT force-requested at vkCreateDevice. Therefore Lavapipe (which needs none of these for saxpy/vector_add) still creates the device and the EXISTING dispatch_saxpy/dispatch_vector_add/m3_bandwidth tests — all of which go through this single device-creation path — keep passing. A kernel that NEEDS an absent feature fails closed at DISPATCH with DeviceFeatureUnsupported (a typed skip), never at device creation. This is the correct CONDITIONAL enablement the prompt required; it is NOT enable-unconditionally-and-hope.

NVIDIA Blackwell: storageBuffer16BitAccess + VulkanMemoryModel + cooperativeMatrix all required and all in the table; subgroupSize==32 guard (HN-4/AT-1507) prevents wave64 silent miscompute. AT-1509/1522 pipeline-create on the mandatory NVIDIA runner are the real proof CRITICAL-2/-3 are fixed (Lavapipe laxity acknowledged in acceptance_risk).
AMD wave64 / Intel SIMD16: subgroupSize==32 guard SKIPS them even if they advertise the shape — r0 OQ-1 resolved.

regression_analysis.metadata_schema_bump_does_not_break_exis: compile_emits_metadata_sidecar.rs:46 asserts meta.schema_version == CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION (the constant, not a literal) — tracks the bump automatically. metadata.rs AT-503 uses a hard literal assert_eq!(CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, 1) — the design EXPLICITLY updates it to 2 (schema_version_test). bench_regression.rs schema_version==1 is for baselines.json (a SEPARATE benchmark-baseline schema, unrelated to KernelMetadata) and is unaffected. ParamBindingPlan serde roundtrip (param.rs AT-508) is unchanged. No metadata-roundtrip or bench baseline regression.
regression_analysis.conditional_feature_enablement_preserves: Verified the single VulkanContext::new device-creation path (context.rs:340-361) is shared by ALL existing GPU dispatch tests. Conditional probe-then-enable means no new feature is force-requested, so vkCreateDevice on Lavapipe still succeeds and saxpy/vector_add/m3_bandwidth keep working. CONFIRMED resolved.
regression_analysis.coopmat_key_emission_invariance: CoopMatKey +2 fields is an internal BTreeMap dedup-key change; OpTypeCooperativeMatrixKHR operands are (M/N/use/elem), unchanged. emit-byte-identity is asserted by AT-1508. Plausible and verified the key is type-cache-only (coopmat.rs:89 BTreeMap<CoopMatKey,Word>).

residual_risk_assessment.feature_struct_lifetime: Addressed: all feature-struct locals declared at function scope (not inside the timeline+1.2 if-branch as today at context.rs:346-356), pNext assembled unconditionally for the supported superset. Coder must ensure each local outlives create_device (Rust borrow trap the current single-branch structure invites) — the design states this explicitly. Non-blocking with the stated discipline.
residual_risk_assessment.derive_coopmat_shape_first_mul_add: Non-blocking for M3.1 single-shape kernels; debug_assert recommended (see warnings).
residual_risk_assessment.metadata_v1_v2: Non-blocking; back-compat relaxation + AT-1553 cover both directions; AT-503 literal updated.

open_question_positions.OQ-2 (Lavapipe skip mechanics): RESOLVED; and now actionable because metadata.coopmat gives the runtime the required shape (C1 fixed).
open_question_positions.OQ-6 (DispatchError count 28->30): Accept; verified current count is 28 (error.rs comment line 7) and two new variants (CoopMatUnsupported + DeviceFeatureUnsupported) are well-formed.

most_dangerous_hole: NONE that is blocking. The r0 most-dangerous compound (C1 no-metadata + C4 loose-tol-transpose-friendly-fixture) is dissolved: the runtime now reads the required shape from metadata.coopmat (no hardcode, no HN-10/AT-1551 contradiction) AND the fixture is numerically transpose-distinguishing by O(100x) the tolerance. The next-most-likely failure is a missed feature-struct lifetime in context.rs (caught loudly by AT-1509/1522 pipeline-create on the mandatory NVIDIA runner), not a silent miscompute.
summary_final: APPROVE. The r1 revision genuinely closes all four CRITICALs verified against the actual code, and crucially avoids the Lavapipe regression by enabling 16/8-bit storage + Int8/Int16 device features CONDITIONALLY (probe-then-enable, fail-closed at dispatch) rather than unconditionally at device creation — so the existing saxpy/vector_add dispatch on Lavapipe is preserved. The metadata schema 1->2 bump is back-compatible and breaks no existing roundtrip/bench/metadata test (the only hard-literal version assert, AT-503, is explicitly updated). K-derivation is sound via the bindings table + the M2.1 KDimMismatch guarantee; the capability->feature table covers every emitted capability; the 'shaderFloat16 not needed' claim is correct. Three NON-BLOCKING implementation notes for the Coder: (1) derive_coopmat_shape must resolve LocalRead operands through body.bindings (matmul_tile uses binding refs, not inline Loads); (2) debug_assert all mul_adds in a kernel share one shape; (3) optionally add the (AB,(AB)^T) output-transpose pair to AT-1512. Coding may proceed.
